question: If myriad creates more than one token for a given player, can I choose separately for each token whether it attacks the player or a planeswalker they control?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you choose separately for each token whether it attacks the player or a planeswalker.
expected.answer: If myriad creates more than one token for any given player (due to an effect such as the one Doubling Season creates), you may choose separately for each token whether it’s attacking the player or a planeswalker they control.
